cohort_stage: Q0 metadata; never repartition after source-only context qualification
hash_rule: SHA256(UTF8(str(seed)+"|"+canonical_ID)); ascending hex digest then canonical ID; rank mod k

nested_rules.outer: A=all_orgs minus H; H features projected on ALS(A); final supervised training features aux4(A)
nested_rules.inner: V one of four folds of A; U=A minus V; V features projected on ALS(U); supervised inner train features aux4(U)
nested_rules.auxiliary: for W one of aux4(T), project W on ALS(T minus W); NO further recursive tuning
nested_rules.reference_population: all Q0 models in reference orgs; per-item minimum20; no global fit; no pruning using other-context qualification
nested_rules.qualification: per-context common finite B/C/L/F rows; shared all17 configs, both endpoints/families; no cross-context union exclusion and no refitting/repartitioning after exclusion
